name: Neon question hook
what: A big neon-outlined question mark on a black screen swings its hook like a pendulum while a question fades in above it word by word; then the mark and the question fall out of the frame and a closing line pops in at the centre and holds.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f10 the mark settles up 56 px (each frame closes 30 % of the gap); f0-f104 its hook swings about the dot, 12 deg each way, one swing every 58 f (right-most at f24 and f82, left-most at f53); the question's words fade in at f2, f7 and f12 (4 f each); f104-f120 the mark and the question fall out together (ease-in, power 2.3); the closing line pops in at f124 and holds to f179

tracks.name: mark settle
tracks.what: the question mark settles up 56 px
tracks.easing: exponential settle (each frame closes 30 % of the gap)

tracks.name: hook swing
tracks.what: the hook swings about the dot, 12 deg each way, 58 frames a cycle
tracks.easing: sine (cosine, right-most at f24 and f82)

tracks.name: fall

tracks.name: closing line
tracks.what: the closing line pops in to 80 % and settles to full
